storyPoints.label: Start
storyPoints.story: Перед рассветом в Кламаре ясно и тихо. Я выдвигаюсь на железнодорожную станцию, чтобы следующие несколько часов кататься на разных транспортных средствах. Люблю public transportation! Сначала поезд до Монпарнаса и метро до Лионского вокзала.

storyPoints.label: Lac du Bourget
storyPoints.story: Чуть меньше двух часов до Лиона -- быстро, комфортно, достаточно скучно. В Лионе пересаживаюсь на электричку до Анси, которая идёт берегом озера Бурже. Ура, наконец-то многообещающие виды!

storyPoints.label: Views from train
storyPoints.story: В Анси сажусь на следующую электричку, она идёт куда-то в Щвейцарию и перемещается с потрясающей пунктуальностью. Чем дальше в Швейцарию, тем больше горных красот видно из окна. Но в Швейцарию мне не нужно, моя цель -- это вот те горы. Так что я выхожу на маленькой станции с очень длинным названием Groisy-Thorens-la-Caille. Сейчас я ещё прокачусь на автобусе и наконец-то начну идти!

storyPoints.label: Real start
storyPoints.story: Aviernoz! Mapy.com и страва готовы, я тоже.

storyPoints.label: Fields and gardens
storyPoints.story: С первых же шагов влезла в крапиву -- ура, приключения! Пробираюсь вдоль огородов под мелодичный перелив коровьих колокольчиков. Стараюсь не разгоняться и идти в темпе разговора с Кристиной -- когда мы гуляли в Польше оказалось, что если идти достаточно медленно, то можно не просто не устать при подъёме, но ещё и поболтать по дороге. Сейчас я иду одна, но темп пытаюсь поддерживать тот же.

storyPoints.label: Sandwich
storyPoints.story: Чем выше, тем более размеченной и расхоженной становится тропа. По дороге мне позвонили из приюта, где я буду ночевать и уточнили, во сколько я приду и нужен ли мне ужин. Оказывается, сеть тут ловит даже лучше, чем у меня дома, так что я зря перестраховывалась и посылала свой маршрут всем друзьям. На повороте дороги открывается вид на долину, озеро Анси и город, его я буду видеть ещё много раз с разных углов. Хорошее место, чтобы съесть бутерброд! Nice place to eat a sandwich (I brought them from Paris), drink some water, and enjoy a view of the lake where I came from and the mountain where I'm heading to. From now on the trail gets more populated and better marked. The route to Parmelan is popular, but I came on Friday, so I guess that's why it wasn't too crowded.

storyPoints.label: Cow band
storyPoints.story: Не очень обитаемое шале и инструментальный ансамбль рогатых исполнителей. Впрочем при ближайшем расслушивании к ангельской мелодии колокольчика примешивается ещё и постоянное жужжание десятков мух, которые мельтешат вокруг. Тяжело быть коровой( Cool cows. They have bells sounding angelically, but when you get close, you can also hear the endless buzz of many flies that swirl around. Poor cows!:(

storyPoints.label: Glacier Aviernoz
storyPoints.story: While the ice itself is probably somewhere deep in the cave and one cannot see it even if climbs higher, the freezing breath of winter is unmistakable. Imagine that in the middle of the hot summer hike you suddenly feel like standing next to an open freezer door. A reminder that winter is coming or that the door of a wardrobe leading to Narnia is just over there.

storyPoints.label: Calcites and martian views
storyPoints.story: I was very glad that the day was dry and sunny, going through this martian calcite landscape in the rain would be impossible, I suspect that rocks are super slippery.

storyPoints.label: First Mont Blanc!
storyPoints.story: I knew that from the refuge it is possible to see Mont Blanc but I didn't know what to expect from it. Should it be something barely visible in the distance? So seeing those mighty snow-covered peaks felt like a gift and a miracle. Couldn't stop taking pictures (can hardly choose one now)

storyPoints.label: Reached the Refuge
storyPoints.story: Reached the refuge! It is much earlier than my original plan, so I have time to explore trails around, eat an apple and rest.

storyPoints.label: Piece of snow
storyPoints.story: About 40 minuts away from the refuge there is a grote which I thought I could check out before dinner. However the trail to the grote was passing mostly through the calcite desert, so eventually I decided that I don't like jumping there with a risk of breaking my leg and went back. But I saw a piece of snow on the way! It didn't make any cold feeling like a glacier.

storyPoints.label: Aggressive chicken
storyPoints.story: Chicken are cool. Maybe replace with some refuge inside pictures and add to the story. Also should mention somewhere that all the choice I needed to make was whether to look left to the Mont Blanc or to the right to the valley and lac du Annecy.

storyPoints.label: Dinner time
storyPoints.story: This is the oldest refuge in France working since 1883. No water. Helicopter food. Visited by Tenzig. Everyone is eating together (a bit pricely, but super tasty). Sleeping with a window (thin walls)

storyPoints.label: Golden hour
storyPoints.story: Probably more refuge stories and memories. E.g. about people and communication.

storyPoints.label: Sunset
storyPoints.story: Watching sunset.

storyPoints.label: Moonrise
storyPoints.story: Whatching moonrise from the first shimmer of moon silver up until the time of the full disk rising over the mountains. The worst time for any stargazing but the evening was magnificent.

storyPoints.label: Night
storyPoints.story: Good night. More hiking awaits tomorrow.

storyPoints.label: Morning
storyPoints.story: Pre-sunrise. Getting up early to stretch, wash myself if possible and watch sunrise.

storyPoints.label: sunrise
storyPoints.story: Sunrise!

storyPoints.label: breakfast
storyPoints.story: Breakfast is more simple than dinner, cereals, bread and butter, orange juice, coffee (I took everything because it was expensive lol) and is meant to be enjoyed outside. Turns out that seeing mont blanc in the morning is more difficult. After breakfast it's time to wave goodbye to the refuge.

storyPoints.label: Cliffs
storyPoints.story: The trail is easy. My initial plan was to go to Naves Parmelan, but then I decided to extend my route and took on a longer path with an idea in mind to go on a smaller mountain just over the lake to get a view of Annecy. Also I was too greedy and decided not to buy water in the refuge. So I started with less than 0.5 L, I guess. The route down is easy, she thought.

storyPoints.label: Balmont (sud)
storyPoints.story: Passing through small peaks, all of them have signs and maps of visible skyline. I'm usually looking back to Parmelan from where I came, it's towering over the nearby landscape.

storyPoints.label: Goose and chalet
storyPoints.story: Chalet with cows, chicken and geese! I'm a city girl so I guess this was the first time when I really saw a farm goose. That's who they are talking about in stories that goose can break a leg with a hit of a wing!

storyPoints.label: mont Lachat
storyPoints.story: Another peak. On this part of the route I was mostly alone (and counting my sips of water in the bottle)

storyPoints.label: signs in the forest
storyPoints.story: Those parts are lacking steep trails and feel mostly educational-recreational. Although I don't know where people are coming from. Maybe from Dingy-Saint-Clair, or from nearby parking lots, I guess. It seems like there is no direct bus from nearby places to Annecy.

storyPoints.label: First Blackberries
storyPoints.story: So I'm driving myself to dehydration and the plan is to cross another mountain and only then get to the bus stop and to the city. Cursing myself for not buying water and thinking that I haven't seen any blackberries along the way. And suddenly, on a steep trail where nobody goes, here they are. Black gold, like a blessing. My spiky source of survival. Murs. Legs like fighting a wild blackberry. Thanks to the forest elves!

storyPoints.label: River fier
storyPoints.story: Ну хотя бы умыться можно! Но пить из речки ершила не стоит. Вот надо всегда таскать с собой обеззараживающие таблетки!

storyPoints.label: mountain
storyPoints.story: Хз что тут происходило, наверное, я просто уставала и хотела пить

storyPoints.label: more Blackberries
storyPoints.story: Больше ежевики богу ежевики. Я, кажется, наелась ежевикой...

storyPoints.label: signs of civilization
storyPoints.story: Water is near! Finally some civilization

storyPoints.label: Apples
storyPoints.story: Бабулечка предложила мне воды, со льдом! Я стырила яблоко из-под яблони. А потом встретила Аниту! И сливы.

storyPoints.label: drink
storyPoints.story: Уточка, лебеди и дети все в одном прозрачном озере, красивый городок с кучей туристов, каналы. Съела ещё полбутерброда. Выпила вечером с Анитой
